spree.customer_mailer.password_reset_ema.subject: {{ store.name }} Password Reset Instructions
spree.customer_mailer.password_reset_ema.body:
{% assign name = customer.first_name | default: customer.email %}
<mj-section>
  <mj-column css-class="hero">
    <mj-text mj-class="heading">Reset Password</mj-text>
    <mj-text mj-class="greeting">Hi {{ name }},</mj-text>
    <mj-text mj-class="lead">We received a request to reset your password. Click the button below to choose a new password.</mj-text>
    <mj-button href="{{ reset_url }}">Reset Password</mj-button>
    <mj-text mj-class="note">This password reset link will expire shortly. If you did not request this, no action is needed.</mj-text>
    <mj-text mj-class="note" padding="16px 0 0">If you did not request a password reset, you can safely ignore this email. Your password will not be changed.</mj-text>
  </mj-column>
</mj-section>

spree.order_mailer.confirm_email.subject: {% if resend %}[Resend] {% endif %}{{ store.name }} Order Confirmation #{{ order.number }}

<mj-section>
  <mj-column css-class="hero">
    <mj-text mj-class="heading">Order Confirmation</mj-text>
    <mj-text mj-class="greeting">Hey {{ order.customer_name }},</mj-text>
    <mj-text mj-class="lead">Please review and retain the following order information for your records.</mj-text>
  </mj-column>
</mj-section>
{% render 'spree/shared/order_summary', heading: heading, purchase: order, items: order.items, totals: true %}
